entries.summary: ≤3-bit quantization hits this MoE's expert weights hard: arithmetic becomes unreliable and tool calls produce malformed arguments.

mitigations.note: Q4_K_M (~19GB) is the sweet spot; if you only have ~13GB free, a smaller dense model at 4-bit usually beats this model at 3-bit.
Offload math to a tool — works because tool calling recovers at 4-bit+, but at 3-bit the tool calls themselves get flaky.

entries.summary: Fast and smart, but its prose reads utilitarian — repetitive sentence rhythms and little voice.

mitigations.note: Model character, not a settings problem. Gemma 3 12B writes better in half the memory.

entries.summary: Qwen3 models fall into endless repetition loops under greedy decoding — the model card itself warns 'DO NOT use greedy decoding'. Quantized builds hit it more often.

mitigations.note: Use the card's sampler settings (temp 0.6 / top_p 0.95 / top_k 20 in thinking mode; 0.7 / 0.8 / 20 non-thinking) and presence_penalty up to 1.5 if loops persist.
